summary.headline: Q1 FY27 total income rose 63% YoY to INR 50.3 crores and PAT rose 382% to INR 15.1 crores, with collections up 68% to INR 131.2 crores.
summary.overview: Management described Q1 FY27 as a strong start, with collections outpacing bookings and profitability improving sharply year on year. Bookings normalised to INR 105.7 crores (1.26 lakh sq ft) after the exceptional Q4 FY26 launch quarter. Margin gains were driven mainly by the high-margin horizontal Imperia Phase 2 project, which accounted for about 85% of quarterly revenue. Management added a 50+ acre Lucknow land contract and about 15 acres of aggregated land, but gave no firm FY27 sales or booking guidance and was cautious on Faith (Trinity) launch traction.

financial_highlights.change: Normalised after Q4 FY26 launch-led peak; no YoY figure given

segments.name: Imperia Phase 2 (horizontal)
segments.commentary: Contributed about 85% of Q1 revenue at approximately 60% gross margin. Management says about INR 170-180 crores of its GDV (about INR 300 crores) is yet to be recognised, predominantly expected in the remaining FY27 quarters.

segments.name: Eldeco Imperia Avenue
segments.commentary: Launched in Q1 with 44 units sold, booking value about INR 14.6 crores.

segments.name: Eldeco Trinity (Faith tower)
segments.commentary: Third and final tower launched mid-June 2026. Sample ready about 10-15 June; two or three bookings so far and a pipeline of about 20-25 bookings in conversion for July-August.

segments.name: Latitude 27
segments.commentary: Completion certificate scheduled for November 2027 across roughly 7-8 towers (GDV about INR 275-300 crores per analyst). Management aims to recognise completed towers from March to May 2027, about 15-20% of GDV, subject to execution and RERA extensions.

segments.name: Legacy ready inventory
segments.commentary: About INR 75 crores of unsold ready inventory in legacy projects. Management expects 40-60% to be liquidated in FY27.

guidance_outlook: FY27 is expected to show reasonably strong growth over FY26 (FY26 topline INR 176 crores, per analyst) and FY28 onwards is expected to be a pivotal change in presales and sales trajectory; no numbers given.
Almost all of the 3.4 million sq ft forthcoming pipeline (serial numbers 4-7) is expected to be launched within FY27, though some projects are still under approvals.
Solano Gardens: 9.5-acre group housing project, tail horizontal inventory and a 5-acre extension; group housing targeted within the year, extension attempted within the year with no commitment.
Management expects a large horizontal development on the 50+ acre Lucknow contract but has not decided the vertical/horizontal mix; no GDV or launch timeline given.
Management plans to keep a balance between vertical and horizontal developments on an opportunistic basis.
All projects have received a four-month RERA extension, citing the Middle East conflict, commodity pressure and labour displacement as timing risks.
capex_capacity: Land: a legally binding contract for more than 50 acres of contiguous land in a prime Lucknow location was executed in Q1; about 15 acres of land aggregation was also completed.
Latitude 27: completed towers targeted for revenue recognition within FY27 or by April-May 2027; completion certificate scheduled for November 2027.
Eldeco Trinity: third and last tower (Faith) launched in mid-June 2026.
Eldeco City Courtyard: a small commercial component of the Eldeco City integrated township, a very small share of salable area in forthcoming projects.
Management is pursuing a land-banking strategy aimed at bringing land to development quickly rather than holding it on the books.
demand_pricing: Q1 bookings normalised after the exceptional launch-led Q4 FY26 performance; management says customer engagement remains healthy.
Management says the strategy is to sell most inventory in the initial launch period; tail inventory is now being sold at current market prices.
Lucknow commercial rates described as steady with an upward trend, but management declined to quote figures.
Management says the Kanpur-Lucknow Expressway is driving inbound migration and housing interest in Lucknow.
Management declined to give FY27 sales or booking guidance; it pointed to presentation data on average realisation for estimation.

qa_highlights.question: Why diversify into projects like Eldeco City Courtyard, and is commercial/mixed-use a larger opportunity?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Courtyard is a small commercial component of the integrated Eldeco City township, needed to meet development control norms; it is a very small share of salable area and Imperia Avenue shows good reception.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the roughly 37% EBITDA margin in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue mix shifted to Imperia Phase 2, a high-margin horizontal project (about 60% gross margin), while Q1 FY26 was dominated by a lower-margin vertical project; management expects horizontal projects to keep margins higher.

qa_highlights.question: How much of Imperia Phase 2 revenue is recognised, and how much is left?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR 170-180 crores of the roughly INR 300 crores GDV is still to be recognised, predominantly in FY27 but timing depends on sales and pricing.

qa_highlights.question: How much legacy ready inventory remains and how much can be sold in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR 75 crores of legacy inventory remains; management expects 40-60% to be liquidated in the current year.

qa_highlights.question: How much of Latitude 27 can be recognised in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Towers are targeted for revenue recognition within FY27 or by April-May 2027; management estimates 15-20% of GDV (about INR 275-300 crores) between March and May 2027, depending on execution and RERA extensions.

qa_highlights.question: Why is Faith tower bookings traction weak, and how is the booking figure reconciled with area?
qa_highlights.answer: Faith launched mid-June after war-related delays; the sample flat was ready 10-15 June, with 2-3 bookings and 20-25 in pipeline. Rajiv Khurana said the slides now show area allotted rather than area booked, since allotment follows booking, and the two are not directly comparable.

risks_watch: Imperia Phase 2 recognition: about INR 170-180 crores of the ~INR 300 crores GDV is still to be recognised, mostly expected in the remaining FY27 quarters, and timing depends on sales and final pricing.

Latitude 27 timing: management targets 15-20% of GDV recognition between March and May 2027, which straddles FY27 and FY28; any slippage depends on execution and RERA extensions after the four-month extension.
Eldeco Trinity (Faith) traction: only 2-3 initial bookings with 20-25 in pipeline for July-August; management deferred the real impact to Q2 results.
Legacy ready inventory of about INR 75 crores; management expects 40-60% liquidation in FY27 with no unit-level breakdown given.

Booking disclosure change: the presentation now shows area allotted rather than area booked on the ongoing projects slide, which management said is not directly comparable to the earlier booking figures.

Pipeline launches: almost all of the 3.4 million sq ft forthcoming pipeline (serial numbers 4-7) is targeted for FY27, with some projects still under approvals; the 50+ acre Lucknow contract has no decided vertical/horizontal mix or GDV yet.

Margin sustainability: Q1 EBITDA margin of 37.1% was driven by Imperia Phase 2 at about 60% gross margin on about 85% of revenue; management expects horizontal projects to keep margins higher but gave no forward margin guidance.
key_quotes: The Q1 FY27 marked a strong start to the year for Eldeco Housing and Industries Limited with collections outpacing bookings, execution activity remaining steady, and profitability improving meaningfully on a year-to-year basis.
So approximately INR 170 crores to INR180 crores depends on where we can land the inventory finally at what rate, that much of the inventory is available.

I would again refrain from making forward -looking statements. But all I can say is that FY28 onwards is going to be a pivotal change in the trajectory of this company in terms of presales as well as sales.

Again, I would not like to make a commitment, but the idea is our internal estimates give us to believe that between March and May, somewhere we will be able to recognize approximately 15% to 20% of this.
summary.management_tone: Confident on execution, collections and the land pipeline, but cautious and evasive on forward numbers: management declined to give FY27 sales or booking guidance, quantum for FY28-29, or GDV and timing for the 50+ acre Lucknow contract. It also deflected on buybacks and the stock's valuation, saying those steps are under active consideration without committing.
